text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Kuu-chan-senpai, haaappy birthday~♡ Did my 
present arrive yet~?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! There was a massive pile of 
rhinestones and beads, it totally blew me 
away~~! Wait, are you sure I can have all 
of that!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Of course♡ They've all got great taste, 
right? Go totally wild with those crafts!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Waaah...! Thank you so much, Pandora-san! 
I'll make lots and lots and loooots of 
them...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
A fruit brooch with large stones, a beaded 
necklace and bracelet, and pairing it with 
ribbons for hair accessories sounds lovely 
too♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I should make a matching one and give 
it to Cesario as a present!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
And and, I wanna make something for 
Heart-san and Messiah-san too~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
For Pandora-chan, I think piling on the 
rhinestones would look super cute~♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
And then we add pearls and amber♡ That's 
right, with a pink base!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey? It's okay for me to look forward 
to it... right?♡

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ahaha!! Of course, leave it to me♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'll make something that's perfect for 
"Pandora-chan"! Look forward to it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Kuu-chan senpai! Love how 
you always get it~♡
